verdict.rationale: Nix's binary cache mechanism (nix-docs-36) and remote builds (nix-docs-30) directly support fast, reproducible installs, and the community confirms binary sharing speeds up dev/CI workflows (nix-comm-9). However, there is no documented CI-specific cache-restore setup (e.g., GitHub Actions cache action, Cachix integration) or explicit offline-install guidance in this evidence pack. missing for 10: CI-specific cache-restore documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions/Cachix setup), explicit offline-mode/air-gapped install instructions, and independent verification of CI speedups.
